cards.timezoneDesc: Defines when your midnight occurs for daily resets, streak calculations, and task reminders.

cards.audioDesc: Customize click sound effects, Pomodoro completion alarms, and relaxing soundscapes.
cards.subscriptionDesc: Manage your active plan, cosmic quotas, renewals, and payment method.

cards.changePasswordDesc: Update your account password. Choose a strong password with letters, numbers, and symbols.
cards.accountResetDesc: Restart your journey by clearing only metrics and achievements, or wiping all content without creating a new account.
cards.dangerZoneDesc: Deleting your account will permanently wipe all your data, tasks, coins, items, and history on HabitParty. This action is irreversible.

dangerZone.modalDesc: Are you sure you want to delete your HabitParty account? All your progress, history, achievements, and settings will be deleted immediately and cannot be recovered.
dangerZone.cardDesc: Deleting your account will permanently erase all your progress, tasks, coins, items, and history in HabitParty. This action cannot be undone.

accountReset.metricsDesc: Clears XP, level, coins/gold, overall streak, achievements, profile highlights, and task streaks/focus counters. You can choose in the confirmation modal whether to delete transaction history and focus records too. Your workspaces, board columns, tasks, checklists, rewards, backpack items, and subscription stay intact.
accountReset.metricsModalDesc: This will permanently reset your XP, coins, overall streak, achievements, profile highlights, and task streaks/counters. By default, your transaction statement and logged focus sessions stay preserved — check the box below only if you want to erase them too.
accountReset.metricsSuccessToast: Metrics, XP, and achievements have been reset!
accountReset.deleteHistoryLabel: Also delete Transaction History and focus records
accountReset.deleteHistoryHint: Removes your entire earnings/spending ledger and logged focus sessions. When unchecked, only counters, XP, coins, and achievements are reset.
accountReset.completeDesc: Deletes all content created by you (workspaces, columns, tasks, checklists, rewards, inventory, focus activities & logs, transactions, achievements, and notifications) and clears bio/avatar frame, while keeping your login, friends, and active subscription.
accountReset.completeModalTitle: Delete all data and start from scratch?
accountReset.completeModalDesc: This action permanently deletes all your workspaces, columns, tasks, checklists, rewards, items, focus activities & records, transactions, achievements, and bio/frame. Your login credentials, email, friends, and active subscription stay preserved so you do not have to sign up again.
accountReset.completeSuccessToast: Account completely reset! Ready for a fresh start.
